# HBOT Chamber Tech

> Designer and manufacturer of architectural hard-shell hyperbaric chambers (HBOT City Tech Series: Oslo, Dubai, Tokyo, Tokyo Plus, Milano, Geneva) featuring CityOS digital control, CitySilent acoustic engineering, 93-95% oxygen concentration, and 24/7 remote telemetry. Engineering roots since 2007. Wellness Series chambers are not medical devices.
